title: 给未来的新铁盒  (A New Tin for Tomorrow)

segments.t: As twilight turns the rooftop-to-tree lanterns golden outside, Chen quietly calls Qing into Room Nine, where a gleaming new blue-and-brass square tin sits beside fresh yellow waxed cloth. Listen to the whole scene first.
老陈！这个闪闪发亮的蓝底黄铜边方铁盒是哪儿来的？！
星期四下午在五金店顺手买的，以防万一嘛。
等等——老陈，您两天前就已经在盘算埋个新时间胶囊啦？！
院子第三块青石板底下的空槽，本来就砌好了结实砖墙。
这么讲究的砖工，往后三十年一直空着岂不是太可惜了？
我也是这么想：纯属实用维修，一点儿也不矫情。
一点儿不矫情，说这话的人连新黄蜂蜡布都剪好方方正正一块啦！
小晴，再开我玩笑，盒盖标签可就不归你写啰。
哎呀，求您让我写标签吧！盖子上写哪一年和什么话呢？
就写：五月与友同启——请于三十个夏天后再开。
谁来挑今晚放进咱们新院子胶囊里的宝贝呢？
叫小美、宋老师和兄弟俩进来——每人添一件这星期最真心的东西。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
老陈！这个闪闪发亮的蓝底黄铜边方铁盒是哪儿来的？！
'Chen! Where did this gleaming blue-and-brass square tin box come from?!' "Shanshan faliang" literally means "sparkling and emitting light" for "gleaming", describing the "tiehe" ("tin box").
星期四下午在五金店顺手买的，以防万一嘛。

'Picked it up at the hardware store on Thursday afternoon, just in case.' "Wujindian" (literally "five-metals shop") is the everyday Chinese name for a hardware store, and "yifang wanyi" means "just in case".
等等——老陈，您两天前就已经在盘算埋个新时间胶囊啦？！
'Wait—were you already planning a brand-new time capsule two days ago, Chen?!' "Pansuan" means "quietly plotting or planning ahead", while "shijian jiaonang" translates "time capsule" directly.
院子第三块青石板底下的空槽，本来就砌好了结实砖墙。
'That hollow pocket under the third courtyard flagstone is already lined with sturdy brick.' "Qihao" means "built cleanly with brick or stone", surrounding the hollow "kongcao" ("empty slot").
这么讲究的砖工，往后三十年一直空着岂不是太可惜了？

'Such careful brickwork—would it not be a shame to leave it sitting empty for the next thirty years?' "Jiangjiu" praises "fine, meticulous workmanship", and "qibushi" sets up a playful rhetorical "wouldn't it be...?"
我也是这么想：纯属实用维修，一点儿也不矫情。
'My thoughts precisely: pure practical upkeep, with zero sentimentality.' "Chunshu" means "purely belongs to" when claiming a practical excuse, while "jiaoqing" teases "getting overly sentimental".
一点儿不矫情，说这话的人连新黄蜂蜡布都剪好方方正正一块啦！

'Zero sentiment, says the man who already cut a neat square of fresh yellow beeswax cloth!' "Fangfangzhengzheng" turns "square" into a crisp four-syllable rhythm to describe how neatly Chen trimmed the "fenglabu" ("beeswax cloth").
小晴，再开我玩笑，盒盖标签可就不归你写啰。

'Watch your teasing, Qing, or you will lose the job of writing the lid label.' "Bugui ni" means "won't be yours to handle", using "gui" for assigning responsibility—softened by the playful ending "luo".
哎呀，求您让我写标签吧！盖子上写哪一年和什么话呢？
'Oh, please let me write the label! What year and message should we put on top?' "Qiu nin" politely begs "please let me", while "biaoqian" names the "label" for the tin's lid ("gaizi").
就写：五月与友同启——请于三十个夏天后再开。

'Write: Opened with friends in May—please open again thirty summers down the road.' "Tong qi" means "opened together", packing "opened with friends" into four crisp written-style characters fit for a time capsule lid.
谁来挑今晚放进咱们新院子胶囊里的宝贝呢？
'Who gets to pick which treasures go into our new courtyard capsule tonight?' "Tiao" means "handpick" or "choose", aimed at the treasured "baobei" going inside.
叫小美、宋老师和兄弟俩进来——每人添一件这星期最真心的东西。

'Call Mei, Teacher Song, and the brothers in here—everyone adds one heartfelt keepsake from this week.' "Tian" means "add one more", and "zhenxin" joins "true" and "heart" for something genuinely meaningful.
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
老陈！这个闪闪发亮的蓝底黄铜边方铁盒是哪儿来的？！
星期四下午在五金店顺手买的，以防万一嘛。
等等——老陈，您两天前就已经在盘算埋个新时间胶囊啦？！
院子第三块青石板底下的空槽，本来就砌好了结实砖墙。
这么讲究的砖工，往后三十年一直空着岂不是太可惜了？
我也是这么想：纯属实用维修，一点儿也不矫情。
一点儿不矫情，说这话的人连新黄蜂蜡布都剪好方方正正一块啦！
小晴，再开我玩笑，盒盖标签可就不归你写啰。
哎呀，求您让我写标签吧！盖子上写哪一年和什么话呢？
就写：五月与友同启——请于三十个夏天后再开。
谁来挑今晚放进咱们新院子胶囊里的宝贝呢？
叫小美、宋老师和兄弟俩进来——每人添一件这星期最真心的东西。
Under the guise of pure brick maintenance, Chen sparks a brand-new thirty-year courtyard tradition! See you next time.
明天见！
